scope: Two exact source-defined inferior thyroid artery identities; draft MRI normal-orientation example only. Existing MRA-case lessons preserved as previousMRI.

identity.coverageNote: Complete source-defined inferior thyroid artery surface, not a complete glandular supply tree. Thyroid/parathyroid tissue and recurrent laryngeal nerves are not supplied by this addition. Exact junctions, lumen and supply territories are not validated. Original coordinates and faces retained; clinical review pending.
identity.name: Right inferior thyroid artery

previousMRI.title: Right inferior thyroid artery · Inferior thyroid artery: distinguish MRA cases from routine MRI · evidence pending
previousMRI.body: Two case reports describe neck MR angiography identifying an abnormal inferior thyroid artery: a right-sided course through thyroid tissue in one report and left-sided aneurysms in the other. These selected cases do not establish routine visibility of a normal artery on structural neck MRI.
bullets: On an acquired neck MRA, check the actual acquisition and trace vessel identity, side and parent independently of the Atlas label. Neither report establishes normal-vessel detection rates or visibility across routine structural MRI sequences.

The right-sided variant and left-sided aneurysmal disease belong to separate published cases, not this generic model or the owner’s scans. Colour, calibre and position of this reference surface do not establish either finding.

Learning check: do the reports prove that a normal inferior thyroid artery is visible on every neck MRI? No. They describe individual MRA examinations, without a normal-vessel detection study or a registered MRI-to-Atlas comparison.

This source surface supplies no acquired scan, measured flow, patient registration, verified recurrent laryngeal nerve relationship or validated procedural corridor. Normal-vessel identification evidence remains needed for the intended MRI protocol.
previousMRI.note: Educational draft only; readiness and revision-bound radiologist sign-off remain pending. Atlas, case and lecture access remain independent.
